item: #18 (leaf-initialization family) — Phase 1: gated shaped-variant rollout of mob-or and mobcap8
commit: 945053a (plan16 committed at HEAD; the temporary ATOMIC_INIT hook in src/search/dfpn/children.rs + examples/init_trace_check.rs were added, measured, and reverted — `git diff --exit-code` verified clean after the revert, release build re-verified, D2(a) salt-0 anchors re-run exact)
hook: temporary env-gated init hook at the (1, 1) fallback site in src/search/dfpn/children.rs (unsolved non-terminal children with no reusable TT bound): ATOMIC_INIT=mob-or -> OR-parent children (n, 1), (1, 1) elsewhere; ATOMIC_INIT=mobcap8 -> both sides min(n, 8); unset -> shipped (1, 1) bit-identical; n = child legal-move count (max 1), computed at the fallback site only; init only, no counters; a belt-and-braces stderr orientation trace (ATOMIC_INIT_TRACE=1) existed only during D2(d) and was removed before any measurement run

run_grid.d2a: pristine product CLI before the hook: stress/m20/m22/m23/dec13/dec10 at salt 0, --tt-size 128 --first-outcome --outcome-only --timeout 600, plan12 caps (stress 2.5 B, m20 2 B, others 1 B)
run_grid.d2c: 12 plan15 anchor cells on the hook build: mob-or/mobcap8 x {stress @ 300 M, dec13, dec10 @ 1 B} at salt 0 + m22 at salts {0,1,2} @ 1 B
run_grid.rollout: 3 arms (base, mob-or, mobcap8) x 22 cases x 6 salts {0..5} = 396 runs; caps inherited from plan12 (stress 2.5 B, m20 2 B, others 1 B); --timeout 600 secondary; base arm run first and D2(a)/(b)-checked before the candidate arms

arms.mob-or: ATOMIC_INIT=mob-or; OR-parent children (n, 1) (defender-to-move child of an OR parent), (1, 1) elsewhere

soundness_invariants.a_pristine_identity: PASS: pre-hook pristine build reproduces plan12 salt-0 counts exactly (stress 249,480,478; m22 14,156,269; m23 9,673,403; dec13 3,822,602; dec10 4,262,128; m20 censored at 2 B); re-run exact after the revert (D2(g))
soundness_invariants.b_hook_nonperturbation: PASS: the hook build with ATOMIC_INIT unset reproduces plan12's recorded per-salt values exactly, all 132 baseline cells (evals AND censoring status)
soundness_invariants.c_plan15_anchors: PASS: all 12 init-on cells reproduce plan15's archived state/arms.json values exactly (mob-or: stress 71,148,597; dec13 486,175; dec10 5,148,137; m22 15,813,483/11,859,889/14,223,312; mobcap8: stress 98,874,361; dec13 509,576; dec10 5,765,793; m22 15,067,529/12,825,207/13,387,712) — pins the init mapping, the child_is_or <-> (n, 1)/(1, n) orientation, and the port fidelity
soundness_invariants.d_orientation_trace: PASS: ATOMIC_INIT_TRACE stderr lines on dec02 (salt 0) match an independent helper (examples/init_trace_check.rs, temporary) root-move by root-move: the first 8 inits are the OR-parent root children, mob-or (n, 1) with the exact child mobilities {7,6,6,8,10,10,10,10}, mobcap8 (min(n,8),1); AND-parent inits observed as (1,1) under mob-or and (1,min(n,8)) under mobcap8
soundness_invariants.e_outcomes: PASS: zero decisive-outcome conflicts within any arm across salts; every uncensored run of every arm matches its fixture expected outcome
soundness_invariants.f_censored_sentinel: PASS: no censored run is decisive (structural check in parse.py)
soundness_invariants.g_revert: PASS: hook + helper deleted, `git diff --exit-code` clean, release build re-verified, D2(a) anchors re-run exact

verdict: reject / reject: both arms rejected per the pinned rule (D3/D6 applied verbatim); mob-or: regressions dec02/dec05/dec06/dec10 + censored-loss m23_white/dec01; mobcap8: regressions dec05/dec10; no defer, so D4 extension does not fire; D6 calibration question not fired (no arm's sole negative is a dec10 regression)
notes: Raw transcripts (RAW=/tmp/plan16/results, ANCHOR_DIR=/tmp/plan16/raw) are not committed per the AGENTS.md measurement layout; driver.py regenerates them deterministically.

The 396-run rollout took ~2 h CPU at <= 3 concurrent processes; candidate arms are faster than baseline on the expensive hard-class cases (stress 0.285x/0.396x salt 0) and slower on dec01 (mob-or), dec05, dec10.
m20_white is unresolved under budget for both arms (candidate censored 4/6 salts at the 2 B cap); per the pinned rule it contributes nothing — see report16.md for the mixed-censoring caveat.
